classification: Resource/transport pilots, not fresh agent-quality scores
prompt_sizing: Actual template/tokenizer counts within5% of target, below context plus output reserve. Resource probes, not agent benchmarks.

adapted_27B_Q4.selection: Stop at first complete resource pass. Other layouts only after hardware/runtime failure; a wrong semantic tool response is not hardware OOM.

remaining_model_layouts: Declare before their first calls using inspected architecture and previous resource observations.
measurements: actual prompt/output/cache counts and complete HTTP bodies
load errors, Docker OOMKilled and exact launch args
memory_scope: 8GiB cgroup cap includes charged file cache, allocations and prompt cache. Record PSS/global host activity to disclose driver/accounting gaps; cap alone is not proof of whole-host delta.
safety: Snapshot original IDs/config/profile; stop only Hermes+llama, never Codex. No public ports. Exact owned cleanup and original readiness restoration in finally. No cache/swap flush or global prune.
